technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with SMA 20/50 golden cross and three white soldiers pattern, but weak trend strength (ADX 17.27), bearish MACD, and price below 200-SMA limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 60 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 11) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity mixed with one senior member exit offset by two junior purchases; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (359.36) combined with flat yield curve and 60-day earnings window creates highly unfavourable macro backdrop for MMM trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: SMA 20/50 golden cross with three white soldiers pattern and contrarian extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis) create technical setup with asymmetric risk/reward near support at 106.52.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below 200-SMA, weak ADX (17.27), bearish MACD, zero fundamental conviction, high earnings risk in 60 days, and macro crisis regime (VIX 359.36) with unfavourable yield curve make this a low-probability setup with poor risk/reward timing.
